text:
sara-partnerships: Quick preflight thread for multi-cloud marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure) + optional appliance co-sell SKU. Scope: publisher IDs, IAM/KMS flow for private offers, SKU packaging (incl. appliance + SI add-on), billing unit, legal copy for data residency and privacy. Keep replies short and assign owners.

nate-cloud: I'll gather publisher account IDs and the minimal IAM/service-account list. FYI: GCP needs a publisher service account + roles/cloudbilling.user; AWS needs an assume-role for marketplace publishing; Azure needs tenant-level publisher principal. Posting samples shortly.

linda-legal: I'll take EULA + short KMS consent paragraph and the MSA blurb for Azure private offers. Also will prepare localized FR/DE snippets for EU listing pages. Need to know whether any raw prompts ever get persisted to logs.

ryan-product: SKU proposal (tentative):
- rdi-lite: dev / free trial, token cap, 14d trial
- rdi-scale: token-metered, 30d trial
- rdi-premium: reserved capacity + SLA + SI add-on option
- rdi-appliance: one-time appliance purchase + install_fee + annual support_tier
- rdi-si: professional services onboarding (per-seat / per-engagement)
Billing unit suggestion: "compute-minute" for appliance & reserved, "token-unit" for bursty usage. Thoughts?

mira-ops: Ops notes: Private-offer requirements: customer KMS key ARN + explicit key policy allowing our publisher role; cross-account KMS policy + sample Terraform for onboarding. Need test KMS ARNs from partner/pilot customers. Also: for Azure private offers we require tenant subscription consent via MS flows.

kai-hw: From hardware partner side: for rdi-appliance listing we need fields for install_region, supported_hardware_ids, and an "on-site_install" SKU. Also want a co-branded logo and a link to the appliance quickstart PDF. Will provide assets.

samir-privacy: Privacy check: We do NOT persist full prompts by default; only aggregated metrics. There is a support-debug opt-in that stores more telemetry for up to 7 days. Legal, include opt-in wording and retention limits. Also ensure manifest references encryption-in-transit and at-rest.

marketplace-bot: Validator rules reminder: uploads will fail if support_contact is missing (MF-002) or if logo asset < 1024x1024 (MF-LOGO). Private-offer flows require KMS_policy field and support_email in manifest.

nate-cloud: Sample AWS KMS cross-account policy snippet (placeholder) below; we'll add a Terraform variant in the shared drive.

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowMarketplaceUse",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::PUBLISHER_ACCOUNT:role/marketplace-run"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

linda-legal: Re: prompt retention  as Samir said, default is aggregated metrics only. I'll draft a short KMS consent paragraph: "Customer provides KMS ARN and consents to cross-account usage for encrypting customer-managed keys. Logs will not include raw prompts unless customer opts into Support Debug mode; retention capped at 7 days." Will add localization notes.

ryan-product: Action items and owners: nate-cloud -> publisher IDs + IAM templates; linda-legal -> EULA + KMS consent + EU text; ryan-product -> finalize SKU manifest + pricing.json; mira-ops -> terraform + KMS playbook + network checklist; kai-hw -> appliance assets + install fields. Target: drafts in shared drive by Tue EOD.

mira-ops: I'll include a short network checklist: VPC endpoints (marketplace egress), allowed CIDR ranges for management plane, and a sample KMS policy for customers. Also note: for dedicated/reserved capacity, we need region affinity mapped in the manifest.

kai-hw: I'll upload logos (SVG + 1024 PNG), appliance spec sheet, and a short install FAQ by Mon. We'll also provide a demo customer for the sandbox.

marketplace-bot: After upload validator run: schema errors posted here with codes. Use #manifest-errors for follow-ups.

sara-partnerships: Scheduling a 30min sync Wed 10am PT to walk the manifest and legal lines before sandbox upload. I'll drop a calendar invite and a one-page preflight checklist (support_contact, logo, pricing.json, KMS_policy).

linda-legal: I'll be on the Wed sync.

ryan-product: I'll draft pricing.json mapping token-unit -> costPer1000Tokens and compute-minute -> costPerMinute; will include SI onboarding SKU pricing recommendations.

nate-cloud: Putting publisher IDs and IAM snippets in the shared drive now and will link in thread.

mira-ops: Terraform snippet + example KMS policy will be pushed to the drive by Tue.

samir-privacy: Quick ask: flag any customers in the EU requiring specific data-residency text so legal can tailor language.

kai-hw: We'll test appliance listing in sandbox once manifests validate; please add "appliance" to sandbox group.

sara-partnerships: Great. Short and actionable. If anyone else from SI or HW side wants to join pilot, reply here and I'll loop them in. :rocket:
